mechanism: Less-liquid cryptoassets may command a return premium as compensation for trading frictions and inventory/liquidity risk. The test asks whether, within a fixed universe of major USD-M perpetuals, a market-neutral long-illiquid / short-liquid portfolio earns positive subsequent weekly returns after conservative costs.

literature_anchor.title: Beyond the Hype: A Multi-Layer Machine Learning Framework for Cryptocurrency Return Forecasting
literature_anchor.public_claim: The paper reports that lower liquidity predicts higher future returns across five major cryptocurrencies.
literature_anchor.boundary: This lab uses a simple classic Amihud-style measure and fixed cross-sectional portfolio; it does not copy or tune the paper's machine-learning specification.

anti_duplication.material_difference: Cross-sectional compensation for low liquidity rather than directional forced flow, momentum or leverage crowding.

source_gate.discovery_required: Each asset >=35/36 monthly archives over 2021-2023 and >=11 months in every discovery year.
source_gate.holdout_required: Each asset >=23/24 monthly archives over 2024-2025 and >=11 months in each holdout year.

feature.daily_log_return: ln(open[t+1]/open[t]) using consecutive UTC daily opens
feature.rank_day: Sunday UTC daily bar, after its day is complete

signal.rank: Sort five assets by trailing 20-day mean Amihud illiquidity using data through the just-completed Sunday.
signal.long: Top 2 most illiquid, equal-weight long totaling +1 notional.
signal.short: Bottom 2 most liquid, equal-weight short totaling -1 notional.
signal.hold: Monday open to next Monday open, exactly 7 days.

pnl.gross: mean(long 7d log returns) - mean(short 7d log returns)
pnl.funding_excluded: Funding cashflows excluded; this is a price/liquidity-premium MVE.

chronology.rule: 2024-2025 holdout outcomes stay closed unless Discovery passes.

no_rescue: Do not change weekly rebalance or 7-day hold.
Do not replace the fixed five-asset universe.
Do not reduce costs after outcomes.
Do not add trend, funding, volatility or market-cap filters.
